roster.name: Hana
roster.title: Investigative reporter
roster.bio: Heard the stories about this hotel. Has a hunch there is a secret, and she is going to find it.

roster.name: Dexter
roster.title: Armchair occultist
roster.bio: Has read every forum thread on the occult and is sure he understands what is happening here better than anyone.

roster.name: Prof. Fenwick
roster.title: Paranormal inventor
roster.bio: Every gadget he ever built exists to prove one thing: the paranormal is real.

roster.name: Mando
roster.title: Reluctant office worker
roster.bio: Won a ticket to this hotel. Just wants to go home and finish his spreadsheet.

roster.name: Scarlett
roster.title: Slasher-movie addict
roster.bio: Has watched far too many horror films and cannot wait to meet something real.

roster.name: General Stahl
roster.title: Military visionary
roster.bio: Plans to weaponize the next paranormal thing he finds and take his country to its next military age.

roster.name: Cornelius
roster.title: Victorian occultist
roster.bio: A genuine occultist, dressed for the last century, thrilled about tonight's meeting.
